description:
Band together with two other allies in the Hardcore Trio challenge! Grab your closest friends and set off on a single-life adventure where you'll need to tackle all vanilla dungeons in order and complete them all before level 60. Delve into the deepest reaches of Azeroth and confront the creatures within, proving your mettle as true Heroes of Azeroth!
